subject: Proposal: shift renewal billing to AWS Marketplace (quote attached)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@thaliumhealth.com>, Alan Kim <alan@thaliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: shift renewal billing to AWS Marketplace (quote attached)

Hi Sara / Alan,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week — appreciate the partnership and the feedback on latency SLAs. To make procurement easier on your side and enable potential co-sell incentives with AWS, I've attached a Marketplace-friendly quote for your upcoming renewal term (file: Q2-Renewal-Quote-Thalium.pdf).

High-level benefits of moving the renewal to AWS Marketplace:
- Single vendor/invoice in your AWS billing console (simpler PO/finance flow)
- Ability to apply marketplace credits / co-sell incentives (if eligible)
- Faster onboarding for any expansion into Dedicated or Private deployments in AWS regions

Two quick asks so we can prepare the right paperwork:
1) Can you confirm whether you need an itemized headcount mapping for licenses or a single line-item subscription?
2) Are there any internal billing constraints (e.g., required PO number format, tax documentation) we should be aware of?

If helpful I can set up a short call with our sales ops lead (Marissa) and the AWS partner rep to walk through next steps. Proposed times: Mon or Tue next week, 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Q2-Renewal-Quote-Thalium.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Sara Patel <sara@thaliumhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Kim <alan@thaliumhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift renewal billing to AWS Marketplace (quote attached)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the prompt follow-up and the quote. A couple of clarifying questions before we loop procurement:

- Can you provide a side-by-side of current direct invoice pricing vs. the marketplace listing (I want to be sure the unit economics align for our CFO)?
- Term and cancellation language: does the marketplace contract mirror our existing terms or are there changes we should expect?
- If we move to marketplace, does billing switch immediately upon signature or at the start of the next invoice cycle?

Alan: looping you to confirm whether you prefer single-line subscription or headcount mapping for licensing.

Jordan — happy to do a 30-min call. Tue morning PST works for me.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Procurement | Thalium Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@thaliumhealth.com>, Alan Kim <alan@thaliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift renewal billing to AWS Marketplace (quote attached)

Sara — great questions. Quick answers inline, plus I attached a short pricing comparison workbook (marketplace-pricing-comparison.xlsx).

- Pricing delta: The Marketplace SKU reflects the same list price for the base subscription; the only change is tax and marketplace platform fees which AWS surfaces on their invoice. In many cases customers find the net spend comparable after co-sell credits; I put a worked example in the spreadsheet.
- Terms: The marketplace listing uses a standard AWS Marketplace term for SaaS subscriptions (12-month default in our listing). Contractual terms (data, SLA) will remain governed by our Redwood terms via the marketplace listing — we can attach a supplemental amendment to preserve specific SLA language if you want that codified.
- Billing cutover timing: In practice we implement an invoice transition window. We can accept the signed marketplace order and schedule the cutover to the next AWS billing cycle (we typically request a 30–60 day overlap to align invoices and avoid double-billing).

Proposed next steps (if you agree):
1) Confirm single-line vs headcount mapping. I recommend single-line subscription unless you plan to scale seats month-to-month.
2) We loop in AWS partner sales to confirm co-sell eligibility and timelines.
3) Marissa will prepare the marketplace amendment/DocuSign.

Available Tue 13 Apr 10:00–12:00 PST — shall I send a calendar invite?

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachment: marketplace-pricing-comparison.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)

From: Hannah R. <hannah.r@amazon.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@thaliumhealth.com>, Alan Kim <alan@thaliumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: shift renewal billing to AWS Marketplace (quote attached)

Hi Jordan / Sara / Alan,

Thanks for the thread — Hannah here from AWS Partner Sales (West region). Happy to jump in. A couple of notes from the Marketplace side:

- Co-sell eligibility: I'll need the HubSpot deal record and renewal ARR to determine co-sell credit tiers.
- Procurement flow: We can support a 30–60 day transition as Jordan suggested. During that window Thalium would see both an AWS invoice (for the marketplace subscription) and the direct invoice; we work with sellers to ensure finance teams reconcile the overlap.
- Action items for us: confirm HS deal id, provide proof of purchase (PO) and assign an AWS partner rep to the co-sell play.

Jordan — pls share the hubspot id and I'll attach the co-sell intake form. Sara — if you can share the expected ARR number for the renewal, that will speed the review.

Cheers,
Hannah R.
AWS Partner Sales
aws-partner-sales@amazon.com

Cc: Hannah R. <hannah.r@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Marketplace amendment and PO guidance

Hi Sara — following up with the paperwork side.

I've drafted the marketplace amendment that mirrors your current SLA and includes a 45-day invoice transition window (to avoid double-billing issues). The DocuSign link is here: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-marketplace-amendment.

For PO guidance: please send any PO with invoice remittance details and the following reference in the PO: "Redwood Subscription — THL-2027-RNW-042". If you need a different PO number format, let me know and we will accept that as the primary reference.

Also, HubSpot record for the deal: HS-43829 — Hannah, Jordan has shared the renewal ARR in the internal tracker.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you'd like to walk through the DocuSign.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this all looks good from our side. Alan and I reviewed the pricing comparison and the CFO signed off on moving the renewal to AWS Marketplace, provided we keep the 45-day transition window (to reconcile with existing POs).

I've attached the PO for the renewal (PO_Thalium_2027_Q2.pdf). Jordan/Marissa — please confirm our start date and whether the marketplace subscription will be active immediately upon DocuSign completion or at the next AWS billing cycle. We'd like the cutover to take effect on 2027-05-01 if possible.

Sara

Attachment: PO_Thalium_2027_Q2.pdf (pdf, 64KB)
